Title: 5-Minute Breakfast Bowl
Script: Start your day with a protein-packed breakfast bowl: microwave oats, add Greek yogurt, berries, and a sprinkle of nuts. Ready in 5 minutes!

Title: Speedy Avocado Toast
Script: Mash avocado on whole grain toast, top with cherry tomatoes and a dash of pepper. Quick, nutritious, and delicious.

Title: One-Pan Veggie Stir-Fry
Script: Chop any veggies you have, toss in a pan with olive oil, garlic, and soy sauce. Stir-fry for 7 minutes. Serve with rice.

Title: Healthy Microwave Mug Cake
Script: Mix banana, oats, cocoa powder, and a splash of milk in a mug. Microwave for 90 seconds for a guilt-free treat.

Title: Simple Tuna Salad Wrap
Script: Mix canned tuna, Greek yogurt, diced celery, and pepper. Wrap in a tortilla for a fast, filling lunch.

Title: Quick Chickpea Salad
Script: Combine canned chickpeas, diced cucumber, tomato, lemon juice, and olive oil. Toss and serve cold.

Title: Instant Veggie Quesadilla
Script: Fill a tortilla with shredded cheese and chopped veggies. Fold and toast in a pan for 3 minutes per side.

Title: Easy Protein Smoothie
Script: Blend frozen berries, banana, protein powder, and almond milk. Pour and go!

Title: Speedy Egg Muffins
Script: Whisk eggs, spinach, and cheese. Pour into muffin tin and bake for 15 minutes. Grab-and-go breakfast for the week.

Title: Lazy Lentil Soup
Script: Simmer canned lentils, diced carrots, celery, and broth for 10 minutes. Season and enjoy.

Title: Greek Yogurt Parfait
Script: Layer Greek yogurt, granola, and fruit in a jar. Perfect for breakfast or snack.

Title: Fast Veggie Fried Rice
Script: Sauté leftover rice with mixed veggies, egg, and soy sauce. Ready in 10 minutes.

Title: Simple Salmon Rice Bowl
Script: Top cooked rice with canned salmon, avocado, and a drizzle of soy sauce. Mix and eat.

Title: Quick Caprese Salad
Script: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella, layer with basil, drizzle with olive oil and balsamic.

Title: Speedy Chicken Wrap
Script: Fill a tortilla with rotisserie chicken, lettuce, tomato, and hummus. Roll and eat.

Title: Healthy Banana Pancakes
Script: Mash banana, mix with eggs, cook small pancakes in a pan. Serve with berries.

Title: Easy Overnight Oats
Script: Mix oats, milk, chia seeds, and fruit in a jar. Refrigerate overnight for a ready breakfast.

Title: Fast Veggie Pasta
Script: Boil pasta, toss with olive oil, garlic, spinach, and cherry tomatoes. Serve hot.

Title: Quick Hummus Snack Plate
Script: Arrange hummus, carrot sticks, cucumber slices, and pita on a plate for a fast snack.

Title: Speedy Apple Nachos
Script: Slice apple, drizzle with peanut butter, sprinkle granola and chocolate chips for a sweet treat.
